name: parameters-a-context-reads
description: A parameter of a function expression the compiler gives a contextual type is not reported when it carries a type annotation, which the call's inference may read. A name an object binding pattern of such a parameter binds that the body never reads is reported at probable, because the code handing the argument may act on the pattern's read of the property. A declared function's unread annotated parameter, and one of a function expression no context types where it is written, are reported. A name an array binding pattern of a local binds and nothing reads is a dead store, whatever element follows it, because the element can be left as a hole.
